target_customer: Data teams and business teams at mid-size companies, later consumer goods and retail field teams
problem: Data teams spent their time maintaining analytics infrastructure and answering requests while business users could not explore data themselves.
business_model: B2B SaaS platform with implementation services
product_category: self-service business intelligence and data platform

founders.name: Emilien Sanchez
founders.background_notes: YC page says former product manager at a data advertising platform.

founders.name: Florian Buguet
founders.background_notes: YC page: head of Customer Success at mediarithmics and consulting at Accenture and Deloitte.

founders.name: Pierre de Poulpiquet
founders.background_notes: YC page: engineer from Paris who began in business consulting then was a product manager at a data marketing startup. Employers not named.

competitors.name: Metabase
competitors.traction_then: Established open source BI with a large user base; date of source not found
competitors.funding_then: Reported tranche of 30M USD, undated and unverified

technical_complexity.rationale: Combining connectors, transformation, modeling and BI front end is broad but built from existing patterns; small team of three.

defensibility.rationale: Crowded BI category with open source rivals; value comes from integration with a customer's data stack.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents kept dominating; Whaly later repositioned to AI platforms for consumer goods and retail field execution.

market_need_then: Rise of the modern data stack in 2020 and 2021 created demand for self-service tools; no dated external spend source was found.

branding.domain_note: Uses whaly.io; no domain history found.

identity.visual_style: icons and customer logos on the site
identity.voice_and_tone: Tagline Smart Decisions Smarter Operations Powered by AI; corporate tone.

brand_strength.rationale: Short playful name but easily confused with other whale named companies; no brand press or community found.

pivots.from: Self-service analytics platform for data teams
pivots.to: AI platform for consumer goods and retail commercial execution (modules include Data Collection, App Builder, Self Service BI, Copilot Builder)
pivots.why: Not stated by a source; the date is approximate and based on the current site compared with the YC description.

outcome_analysis: Whaly is a three-founder Paris company that joined the Summer 2021 batch, raised a 1.9M USD seed in mid 2022 and later moved toward AI platforms for consumer goods and retail, with named customers such as Danone and Tropicana on its site. No acquisition, shutdown or layoffs were found, and funding beyond the seed was not found, so growth stage remains unclear.
notes: Round date conflicts: Redalpine post dated 10 July 2022 and CB Insights 11 July 2022, Seedtable and Caplight say June 2022. Lead is Redalpine per the company post and TheSaaSNews, but CB Insights lists Kima Ventures and Y Combinator only. CB Insights also shows an August 2021 convertible note seen only there and unverified. Total raised ranges 1.9 to 2.4M USD by source. Competitor entry for Metabase is from an undated comparison page. A first fetch of whaly.io was rate limited and a later one succeeded.
